title: Peruvian tridactyl mummies scanned
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Peruvian tridactyl mummies scanned, about 2025 at Peru, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It was insane. I mean, it was it was I was trying to like I think it I think it broke my brain a little bit.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2025 he saw scans of mummified bodies from Peru that have three fingers on each hand, a find some say is not human. He says it was insane and that it broke his brain a little, and he credits a contact, Brigham Buhler. If true, it would mean physical remains of a non-human being exist.
